newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit signs pact to upgrade Hawk.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit signs pact to upgrade Hawk.

text.p: Raytheon Co's electronics systems unit said Friday it has signed a contract worth $206 million to remanufacture eight Hawk fire units for Egypt.

The Hawk assets to be remanufactured were previously provided to Egypt by the U.S. government as excess defense articles, the company said. The contract is with the U.S. Army missile command in Huntsville, Ala.

Under the deal, Raytheon is to produce modification kits to upgrade Hawk to the latest configuration. It also is to provide spares, training and training simulators, test equipment and technical assistance in Egypt when the systems are delivered.
The Hawk missile system forms the backbone of Egypt's air defense command, Raytheon said.
